name: mGBA (Game Boy)
location: Next to the ROM, or in mGBA's savegamePath
notes: Cartridge RAM, followed for MBC3 cartridges with a clock by the 48 bytes of struct GBMBCRTCSaveBuffer (mGBA src/gb/mbc.c, GBMBCRTCWrite and _GBMBCAppendSaveSuffix), written right after the RAM: the footer is there when the file size modulo 256 is 48. It is removed on read and never written.
